title: ring_scratch in growth_plan_demand binds the default heap allocator implicitly and is never freed — per-window leak in every dublin run, contradicting its own temp-arena comment
detail: A bare [dynamic]u32 appended with no allocator binds context.allocator (default heap), not the temp arena — so the 'freed by the frame's free_all' lifetime claim is false. No delete exists on either return path; every 80-tick growth window in a dublin run leaks the backing array (unbounded session growth — the R2-W4 bug class), violating ODN-18's explicit-allocator rule that roster/gview follow.
recommended_fix: Allocate with an explicit allocator and free it: ring_scratch := make([dynamic]u32, 0, 64, context.temp_allocator) + defer delete(ring_scratch), matching growth_terminal_roster/group_cluster_view_build; correct the comment.

title: App boot-policy procs (PP_MAP env name, user-ruling default, corrupt-asset fallback) placed in package render on a testability rationale that doesn't hold — package main is CI-tested
detail: CI runs odin test app (package main, 3× plus the PP_DEBUG leg) alongside app/render, and app/ already holds pure tested logic (noc_toggle, settings, pullback). Putting MAP_SOURCE_ENV/MAP_SOURCE_DEFAULT/map_source_after_load in the view package makes render own app-composition boot policy; main.odin now imports its env-tunable semantics from rnd.*.
recommended_fix: Move map_source.odin + its test to package main (app/), e.g. beside settings.odin; render keeps only the view-facing map_source/board fields it actually consumes.

title: Map_Source enum is defined but never used as a type — every field, param, and return is raw u8 with u8(pp.Map_Source.Dublin) casts at each use site
evidence: core/map.odin:45: Map_Source :: enum u8 {   ...   core/types.odin:539: 	map_source: u8, // Map_Source (0 = Procedural — the zero value; 1 = Dublin)   ...   app/main.odin:94: 	map_source: u8, // pp.Map_Source   ...   app/render/view.odin:91: 	map_source: u8, // pp.Map_Source (0 = Procedural; 1 = Dublin)   ...   app/render/map_source.odin:23: map_source_from_env :: proc(env: string) -> (src: u8, warned: bool) {
detail: The enum exists only as a constant namespace. Raw u8 storage admits out-of-range bytes (e.g. 2): serialize.odin hashes any !=0 byte as a distinct source while map_draw treats anything != u8(Map_Source.Dublin) as procedural — the two consumers would silently disagree. Typing fields as pp.Map_Source makes invalid values unrepresentable and removes every cast.
recommended_fix: Type Run_State.map_source, View.map_source, App.map_source, Demo.map_source and the map_source_* procs as pp.Map_Source (cast to u8 only at the serialize/demo-parse edges), or drop the enum if raw u8 is intended.

title: Lifecycle comments claim teardowns that don't exist: App.board 'freed at exit' and dublin_render_destroy 'called by view teardown' — neither free path is ever invoked
detail: Process-exit reaping is the actual (and acceptable, matching map_cells/fonts) practice — the harness says so honestly ('the harness's board cache lives for the process'). The app-side comments instead describe an ownership/teardown architecture that isn't implemented, which misleads the next agent wiring shutdown or leak-hunting.
recommended_fix: Either add the teardowns (map_board_destroy(&app.board) + a view teardown calling dublin_render_destroy/UnloadFont at exit) or rewrite both comments to the harness's honest 'lives for the process' phrasing.
